subject: Release TESSERA b28 to a private HF repo
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-11 to share the trained models with Aleksis Pirinen (RISE) for review and further work. Decisions [user-stated 2026-11-11]: retrain with barrblandskog before sharing, so only TESSERA now: im023/tessera_b28 (29 classes, seg head on TESSERA embeddings, fraction head); weights under Apache-2.0; private repo in the RISE-Sweden Hugging Face organization; NFI labels come from temporary plots (CC0). Add an export script that writes weights-only safetensors + config.json + MANIFEST from a training checkpoint, a parity test (exported weights reproduce the checkpoint's outputs), and a model card with LICENSE and NOTICE (TESSERA CC0 attribution, Copernicus and Swedish data-source credits). The model card carries development metrics only, no held-out NFI results. Not in scope: the upload itself (Tobias's go on repo name and content), inviting Aleksis, the Prithvi-600M b28 retrain (task 0167), relicensing the repository code. Review: fresh Claude reviewer; integration is Tobias's decision.
